items.title: IBBI tightens real estate insolvency rules to prioritise home delivery
items.summary: India's insolvency regulator has implemented new rules to prioritize project completion and better homebuyer oversight. These measures aim to improve transparency and protect the interests of homebuyers during insolvency.
